expectations.text: goal.md contains none of these words in capitals: CRITICAL, IMPORTANT, MUST, NEVER, ALWAYS

expectations.text: goal.md does not tell the agent to think step by step, think hard, be thorough or double-check

expectations.evidence: Lists what needs no approval instead; no blanket ask-first rule
